surfaces.notes: Built (lane ENTAPI-H, T-697): driver internal/vendorapi/anthropic UserCostReport (bucket_width 1d, group_by product, limit 1000), conformance against the vendormock mock, landed as per-identity USD facts (cost and list_cost, the decimal-string cents converted exactly to micro-dollars; a non-USD currency fails the page) and request counts, coverage seat users only. Synthetic only, no vendor response observed. Synthetic rung assumption_tested, not mock_verified: the corpus pages adjust the official example's placeholder bucket bounds and the null-unless-grouped fields, graded Inferred, which caps the evidence ceiling. Secret class reviewed: amounts, product labels, user id and email, never a credential. The actor name and the deprecated actor.email never land; emails resolve through the identity seam (ASCII only) and are otherwise held, a null or non-ASCII email lands by user id. Residual: Enterprise cost can be restated until about 7 days after the month ends, but each run only re-reads inside the 24h settle lag, so a later restatement is not picked up unless a backfill re-reads that day. Never on a spend path (invariant I4).
